title: Attacking the 'gaunt wolf' (flavor text: 'does not move first') triggered 'Lys disapproves,' but the room had ordinary movement exits I could have used to simply leave — exactly as with the visually identical 'ash wolf' at Twin Stones, where Lys explicitly said 'Leave it. It isn't hunting... We can go around.' Nothing told me the gaunt wolf fight was optional too.
